title: Iceland: the Golden Circle and the south coast
summary: Eight days by car on the route almost every trip to Iceland takes: geysers and waterfalls of the Golden Circle, black-sand beaches near Vík and a glacier walk by the Jökulsárlón lagoon.
season_note: June to August: 18 to 24 hours of daylight and 10 to 15 °C, with rain and wind on many days. Waterproofs are the most important thing in the bag.

stops.name: Reykjavík
plan: Arrive. The old harbour and the Harpa concert hall.
Hallgrímskirkja tower, the city centre and a local swimming pool.
do: A local geothermal pool, such as Sundhöllin or Vesturbæjarlaug, for a fraction of the Blue Lagoon's price.
Shop at the supermarkets (Bónus, Krónan): eating out every night is very expensive.
skip: Booking every meal in restaurants: prices are among the highest in Europe.

stops.name: Golden Circle (Laugarvatn)
plan: Pick up the car. Thingvellir's rift valley, the Strokkur geyser and Gullfoss. Sleep near Laugarvatn.
do: Be at Geysir early or late: Strokkur erupts every few minutes and the tour buses come at midday.
Snorkel the Silfra fissure in Thingvellir, in a dry suit (book ahead).
skip: Driving the Golden Circle as a day trip and back to Reykjavík: sleep on the route and start the south coast fresh.

stops.name: Vík
plan: South coast waterfalls: walk behind Seljalandsfoss, then climb the stairs above Skógafoss.
Reynisfjara's black beach and basalt columns, the arch of Dyrhólaey.
do: Walk behind Seljalandsfoss in a waterproof jacket and shoes: you get soaked.
Puffins nest on Dyrhólaey from May to August.
skip: Turning your back to the sea at Reynisfjara: sneaker waves have killed people there. Stay far from the water's edge.

stops.name: Skaftafell
plan: Drive across the lava fields. Hike to Svartifoss, then a guided glacier walk with crampons.
Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon by boat, and Diamond Beach across the road.
do: A guided glacier walk on Falljökull or Svínafellsjökull: crampons and helmet included.
Jökulsárlón early or late, when the light is low on the icebergs.
skip: Walking on a glacier without a certified guide: the cracks are hidden under snow.

stops.name: Reykjavík
plan: About four hours back west. The Blue Lagoon on the way to the airport, if you want it.
do: The Blue Lagoon is 20 minutes from Keflavík airport: do it on the way out, and book a slot ahead.
